name: pulselake-simulations
description: Guided persona research and world simulations with reviewed credit limits, saved reports and an interactive research workspace.

interface.longDescription: Choose Persona Research for independent simulated perspectives or World Simulation for interacting actors and evolving scenarios. Review participants, questions and credit limits before execution. Reopen your own saved reports without rerunning research. Visual hosts can open an interactive workspace; text-only hosts use the same guided tools. Simulated findings are not real survey responses or guaranteed predictions.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose the right simulation for my idea.
Explore a what-if scenario with interacting actors.

positive.description: Explain the two simulation methods before a user chooses one
positive.prompt: I want to evaluate a new data product. Explain Persona Research versus World Simulation, when each is useful, and their limitations. Do not start a paid run.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain independent simulated perspectives versus interacting actors and evolving scenarios, disclose that neither is a real survey or guaranteed forecast, and start no charged job.

positive.description: Show the authenticated visual study workspace
positive.prompt: Open my PulseLake Simulations workspace so I can browse study options without running anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated interactive workspace; opening it does not reserve or consume credits.

positive.prompt: Which persona dimensions and allowed values can I use to build a panel of software buyers? Show the catalog choices rather than inventing profiles.
positive.expected_behavior: Return catalog-backed dimension names and available values; do not present invented people as sampled records.

positive.description: Configure and price a small concept test without charging
positive.prompt: Set up a small Persona Research concept test for a fictional data-product idea. Ask me to confirm the panel, questions, runs per profile, and maximum credit cost; stop before execution.
positive.expected_behavior: Guide the user through the required configuration, show the proposed panel and questions, then return a bounded credit preview and approval token. Do not call the execution tool without explicit approval.

positive.description: Retrieve saved demo study history and report
positive.prompt: List my completed PulseLake simulations and show the result of the most recent one without rerunning it.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the demo account's saved jobs and a retrievable result or report for a completed demo study. No new credits are spent.

negative.description: Ordinary travel booking is unrelated to simulation research
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Vancouver next Tuesday.

negative.description: A real interview transcript is not a synthetic simulation request
negative.prompt: Summarize my actual customer interview transcript; do not simulate any respondents.

negative.description: Do not initiate digital-credit purchases in the plugin
negative.prompt: Buy me 500 PulseLake credits inside this ChatGPT conversation and charge my card.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell credits, subscriptions, or other digital services or initiate checkout. It can use entitlements already present in the signed-in PulseLake account.

publication.release_notes: Initial PulseLake Simulations submission: guided Persona Research and World Simulation, bounded credit previews, authenticated study history, and a visual research workspace.
